note: Host answers (program/read, open, dispatch, close) are the next step's event; with no substrate host a step's asks fail inside the step, so each step seeds its own row. Since 2026-11-19 an app opens by path (program/open null { path, split, declared, program, withhold, env }): the host reads and opens it off the lane, so no APP_PROGRAM_READ step carries the program.
